## Invitations

A total of 2403 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Of those invited, 263 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 10.9. This provides a summary of participation in the outreach activity and indicates that only a proportion of those invited attended. The attendance figure should be considered alongside the number of invitations issued when reviewing the overall reach of the activity.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS: the recorded SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded reminder total was 0. The results therefore reflect invitations made through other contact arrangements, without additional SMS contact or reminder activity.
